name: The Backrooms
description: An internet-born horror concept describing an endless extradimensional maze of empty yellow-walled office space, reached by 'no-clipping' out of reality. Originated as a single anonymous 4chan /x/ post on 12 May 2019 and grew into a sprawling collaborative fictional universe.

aliases.name: Level 0

aliases.name: Noclip realm
aliases.meaning: Internet jargon: a place reached by 'no-clipping out of reality'

aliases.region: Online community usage — overlapping with the broader 'liminal spaces' aesthetic

regions: Anglophone internet; English-language imageboard and wiki communities
origin: The Backrooms is a digital-era folkloric phenomenon distributed over the global Anglophone internet — primarily through 4chan, Reddit, YouTube, dedicated wikis (backrooms.wikidot.com, backrooms-wiki.fandom.com), and TikTok.
